verdict.rationale: There is no documented public REST API or custom-integration framework in the evidence; integrations are described only as auditor-vetted native connectors. The closest programmatic path is the official MCP server, which can add comments, attachments and status updates to evidence requests. That is an AI-assistant interface rather than a developer integration API, so it offers only a glancing workaround for pushing evidence. Missing for 10: documented developer API (REST/SDK) for pushing evidence, support for pushing automated test/monitor results, custom/private integration framework, auth/token docs for integrations, hands-on corroboration.
